title: My Sister Forged A Codicil, Sold Dad's $275K Gold Coins. So I Watched Her Wear Counterfeit Love.
description: After my sister forged a codicil and sold Dad's $275K pre‑1933 gold coin collection, a hidden cell phone video exposed her fraud and I recovered every coin. Now she polishes display cases in my coin gallery wearing a shirt that reads Counterfeit Love, and each coin's certificate prints her perjury case number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #GoldCoins
thumb_text: SHE SOLD DAD'S COINS, NOW SHE WEARS COUNTERFEIT LOVE
pinned_comment: If your sister forged a codicil and sold your dad's $275K gold coin collection, would you have opened a coin gallery just to make her wear a Counterfeit Love shirt and print her perjury case number on every certificate? Share your story.
